title: "Status, evidence, and provenance"

## What this report establishes {#sec-status}

This is a pedagogical implementation of the pre-shell-crossing cold sheet, using nLPT through fourth order and conservative simplex observables. It reproduces the existing numerical core and adds a controlled EdS PM comparison and directional-derivative laboratory. The scientific motivation is the existing filtered-cosmology evidence described in @sec-published-evidence. Smaller scales and post-crossing dynamics are outside this report's scope.

| Claim or capability | Evidence | Practical limit |
|---|---|---|
| nLPT recurrence through fourth order | Equation residuals, 2LPT closed form, growth tests | Finite Fourier grid and input bandwidth |
| Conservative sheet deposit | Analytic moments, independent R3D fixtures, mass tests | Exact for the represented affine sheet |
| Continuous simplex Fourier modes | Analytic transforms and low-mode deposit comparison | Finite Lagrangian mesh; selected mode coverage |
| PM dynamics | Uniform/plane-wave benchmarks and convergence tests | Finite force mesh and timesteps; live EdS model |
| Directional derivatives | Independent centered finite differences | Fixed cosmology, pre-crossing regime, smooth branches |
| Published PDF agreement | Packaged original summaries and source metadata | Original filters and small crossing contamination |
| General sub-percent 4LPT accuracy | **Not asserted** | Must specify observable and validation domain |

The [release verification record](https://github.com/yipihey/precrossedsheet/blob/main/docs/verification.md) lists commands actually run and remaining checks. Passing a browser demonstration does not certify inference accuracy; passing a local build does not confirm a deployed GitHub Pages site.

## Lineage and citation

This repository is [yipihey/precrossedsheet](https://github.com/yipihey/precrossedsheet). The interface and publication machinery come from [quadrant](https://github.com/yipihey/quadrant). The original Rust mathematical/geometric core comes from [Hopf–Cole cosmology](https://github.com/yipihey/hopf-cole-cosmology); the archived validation and implementation comparison come from [DiscoDJ.jl](https://github.com/yipihey/DiscoDJ.jl). The [evidence audit](https://github.com/yipihey/precrossedsheet/blob/main/docs/evidence-audit.md) documents the precise scope of the imported claims and code paths.

Cite this teaching implementation using `CITATION.cff`, and cite the primary papers and original studies for the scientific claims. No DOI or precision-performance claim is invented for this first implementation.

The footer gives build {{< var build.sha >}} and the build date {{< var build.date >}}. Share the laboratory URL to reproduce its controls; download SVG/CSV/PNG for a saved figure. Hypothesis annotations and the repository's issues provide routes for corrections.
